label: Payfort / Amazon Payment Services
notes: Amazon Payment Services (formerly Payfort) is widely used across MENA. Get test credentials from your APS merchant portal. Sandbox base_url: https://sbpaymentservices.payfort.com/FortAPI. The adapter signs every request with HMAC-SHA-256 using sha_request_phrase from your portal, and verifies inbound responses with sha_response_phrase. Both phrases are required for production; the adapter will refuse to trust an unsigned response if you've configured sha_response_phrase. See bridge/docs/card-terminals.md for the full setup walkthrough.
